_comment: NTUA's official academic calendar 2026-2027, transcribed by hand from the two NTUA Senate decisions that <feed> (SAMPS) links on https://<feed>.ntua.gr/el/education/academic-calendar (scanned PDFs, no text layer). 'el' is the decision's own wording; 'what' is what the tool prints. Movable feasts (Clean Monday, Easter break, Holy Spirit Monday) are named, not dated, in the decisions: dated here from Orthodox Easter 2027 = 2 May. 'p': ug = undergraduate decision, pg = postgraduate decision, all = in both (days with no classes or exams). 'end' is inclusive. Replace the whole file when the next year's decisions are out (agent-tools README, Academic calendar).
